Title: Dialogue
Description: A LowTalk dialogue. Save into Server/LowTalk/Dialogues of an asset pack; the file name is the dialogue id.

Options.Label: NPCs
Options.Description: Which NPCs use this dialogue: role ids (Kweebec_Merchant) or @tags set with /lowtalk tag. Empty means command only.

Options.Label: Speaker
Options.Description: Default speaker for lines without one. Defaults to the NPC's name.

Options.Label: Title
Options.Description: Window title. Defaults to the speaker.

Options.Label: Scope
Options.Description: Variable namespace shared with other dialogues that declare the same scope. Defaults to the dialogue id.

Options.Label: Portrait
Options.Description: Image beside the text, a path inside Common/UI/Custom of any pack.

Options.Label: On
Options.Description: join opens this dialogue by itself when a player joins.
